name: print-social-yellow-and-black-brand-strategy-post-mosaic-with-portuguese-copy
title: Yellow, black and white post mosaic with floppy disk, stickers, cutouts and stacked bold headlines
whatItIs: A pin preview of twelve portrait posts in yellow, black and photo: a floppy disk label, a hanging air-freshener tree, portrait cutouts with yellow rectangles, and bold stacked headlines like 'Se a sua marca some no meio da multidão' with yellow highlight blocks and grid shapes.
whatItMeans: Bold and irreverent; yellow blocks over black-and-white photos feel like marketing zine pages.
techniques: Put yellow rectangles over photos as text holders.
Use quirky retro objects (floppy disk, air freshener).
Stack heavy headlines with keyword highlights.
Keep a yellow, black and white palette.

vocabulary.definition: A yellow rectangle behind text over a photo.
A post starring an old-tech object.
A coloured block behind key words.
